data.narrative:
SunDrive Solar is a Seed-stage climate and energy company founded by Vince Allen and David Hu. The company has raised A$60M+ including a A$25.3M ARENA grant in November 2025. The broader Climate & Energy sector includes 9 private peers and 1 public comparable (LNZA), though none share sufficient overlap in stage or valuation tier to support peer-median benchmarking.

The Stage-Progression method is the primary applicable approach. Using total raised as a valuation proxy ($4M) and applying a standard Seed-to-next-stage multiplier of 2.5x yields an implied valuation of $10M. The Peer-Median method is not applicable due to insufficient narrowly-filtered comparables—while 9 same-sector peers exist, none qualify as adjacent-stage or similar-tier datapoints, and relying on all-sector medians would introduce undue noise.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $8M to $12M, with a midpoint of $10M. This range reflects the limited methodological foundation and the early-stage nature of the company. Key uncertainties include the timing and terms of the next funding round, which will materially reset valuation, and the absence of narrowly-comparable peers at the same stage and sector to validate the step-up multiplier. The A$25.3M ARENA grant provides significant non-dilutive capital but does not directly calibrate equity valuation. Further evidence from Series A pricing or additional comparable transactions would be required to narrow this range.
